Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:10:1.hebrew: אלא - טעמא ודאי משום דאין חבטה פחות מעשרה הוא, ולרב נחמן לא תקשי, דקסבר ר"נ כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:10:1.english: Rather - The reason is certainly because there is no [fatal] impact [from] less than ten [handbreadths], and there is no difficulty for Rav Nachman, for Rav Nachman holds, etc.:

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:12:1.english: Where it rolled - [The animal] was lying down, rolled, and fell [into the pit].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:13:1.hebrew: השני חייב - והראשון פטור, ובגמרא מוקי לה בשהניחו ראשון לשני משתמש ודולה כשהלך לו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:13:1.english: The second is liable - And the first is exempt; and in the Gemara, it establishes it [as a case] where the first left the second using [it] and drawing [water] when he went away.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:16:1.hebrew: אין שליח לדבר עבירה - להתחייב שולחו, אלא שליח מיחייב. וסברא הוא, דאמרי' ליה: דברי הרב ודברי התלמיד, דברי מי שומעין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:16:1.english: There is no agency for a transgression - for the one who sent him to become liable; rather, the agent is liable. And it is [a matter of] logic, for we say to him: [Between] the words of the Master [God] and the words of the student [the sender], whose words do we heed?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:17:1.english: This works out well according to Rabbi - Who says later [that we hold] both of them [liable] for damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:17:2.english: And in [a case of] damage, you find it - That both of them are liable.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:17:3.hebrew: אלא לרבי ולמיתה - דבמיתה מודה דאחרון חייב ולא ראשון, היכי משכחת לה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:17:3.english: But according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] and for death - For in [a case of] death, he concedes that the last [partner] is liable and not the first; how can you find it?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:18:1.hebrew: שעקרו שניהם - שחפר האחד תשעה, ובא חבירו וסייעו, ועקרו בבת אחת חוליא מקרקעותיו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:18:1.english: That they both extracted - That one [person] dug nine [handbreadths], and the other came and assisted him, and they simultaneously extracted a chunk [of earth] from its bottom.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:18:2.hebrew: והשלימה לעשרה - דאין כאן אחרון (לנזקין), דתרוייהו כי הדדי משוו ליה בור, ובין לרבי ובין לרבנן חייבין במיתה, וכ"ש בנזקין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:18:2.english: And he completed it to ten [handbreadths] - For there is no last [digger] here (for damages), since both of them equally make it a pit; and both according to Rabbi and according to the Rabbis they are liable for death, and all the more so for damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:19:1.hebrew: והשלימה לעשרה - דאין כאן אחרון (לנזקין), דתרוייהו כי הדדי משוו ליה בור, ובין לרבי ובין לרבנן חייבין במיתה, וכ"ש בנזקין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:19:1.english: And completed it to ten - For there is no "latter [digger]" here (for damages), since both of them equally make it a [ten-handbreadth] pit; and both according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] and according to the Rabbis, [both] are liable for death, and all the more so for damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:1:1.hebrew: לא משום דלית ביה הבלא - אבל חבטה אית ביה, ואפ"ה פטור כרב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:1:1.english: No, because there are no fumes - But there is impact, and even so, he is exempt, in accordance with Rav.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:21:1.english: [They] are necessary - As we said earlier in our chapter (Bava Kamma 50a).

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:22:1.hebrew: אחד ולא ב' - מעטיה קרא לראשון כדמפרש לקמיה. וכי מעטיה, לנזקין מעטיה, דאי ממיתה לא אצטריך קרא, דהא לא עבד שיעור מיתה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:22:1.english: One, and not two - The verse excluded the first [digger], as it explains further on. And when it excluded him, it excluded him with respect to damages; for regarding death [liability], a verse is not needed, since he did not make the [required] measure for death.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:28:1.hebrew: שור פסולי המוקדשין - כגון בכור בעל מום שהוא של כהן, דקרינן ביה "שור רעהו", או שור קרבן שנפל בו מום ונפדה, דקרינא ביה "שור רעהו". ואפ"ה לענין בור פטור, דכתיב: "והמת יהיה לו" — מי שראוי לו להאכיל נבילתו לכלבים, יצא זה כו', דהכי אמרינן בבכורות (דף טו.) גבי פסולי המוקדשין שנפדו: "תזבח" ולא גיזה, "בשר" ולא חלב, "ואכלת" ולא לכלביך. אבל שור שנגחו חייב, כדמפרש לקמיה בפירקין. ולהכי נקט פסולי המוקדשים, דאילו קדשים תמים — מאי אריא בור? אפי' שור שנגחו נמי פטור, דכתיב "שור רעהו", ולא שור הקדש:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:28:1.english: A disqualified consecrated ox - For example, a blemished firstborn [animal], which belongs to a kohen, so that we apply to it [the verse] "his neighbor's ox," or an ox [designated as] an offering that developed a blemish and was redeemed, so that we apply to it "his neighbor's ox." Even so, with respect to a pit, [the pit's owner] is exempt, as it is written: "And the carcass shall be for him" — [meaning] one for whom it is permitted to feed its carcass to the dogs, excluding this [disqualified consecrated ox], etc. For so we say in Bekhorot (15a) regarding disqualified consecrated [animals] that were redeemed: "[then you may] slaughter" — and not [use its] shearing; "flesh" — and not [its] milk; "and you may eat" — and not [feed it] to your dogs. However, [regarding] an ox that gored it, [the goring ox's owner] is liable, as [the Gemara] explains later in our chapter. And for this reason [Rava] specifically chose disqualified consecrated [animals], for as for unblemished consecrated [animals] — why speak specifically of a pit? Even [if] an ox gored it, [the owner] is also exempt, as it is written "his neighbor's ox," and not an ox of the Temple treasury.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:29:1.hebrew: לאו ממילא כו' - כלומר, תרתי שמעת מיניה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:29:1.english: Is it not [learned] by itself, etc. - That is to say, you learn two [things] from it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:30:1.hebrew: סייד וכייד - שמתחילה רחב היה, ולא היה בו הבל כל כך, וזה שסיידו קצרו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:30:1.english: Plastered and cemented - For originally [the pit] was wide, and there was not so much noxious air in it, and this [person] who plastered it narrowed it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:30:2.hebrew: כייד - עשה בו ציורין בכתלים, בטיח הסיד שטח בו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:30:2.english: Kiyyeid - He made designs in it on the walls, with the lime plaster [that] he smeared on it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:3:1.hebrew: ולטעמיך נעביד י' - דהא בעשרה מיהא מודית דיש חבטה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:3:1.english: And according to your reasoning, let us make [it] ten [handbreadths] - For at ten [handbreadths], at least, you admit that there is an impact.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:3:2.english: A good death - That he should die quickly.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:4:1.english: That he becomes disfigured - For he becomes [dismembered into] limbs.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:5:1.hebrew: ממנו ולא לתוכו - בית גבוה מרה"ר שראוי ליפול ממנו לרה"ר חייב במעקה, ולא בית עמוק מרה"ר, שהנופל נופל על גגו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:5:1.english: From it, and not into it - A house higher than the public domain, from which one is apt to fall into the public domain, requires a parapet; and not a house lower than the public domain, where one who falls falls onto its roof.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:6:1.hebrew: גבוה ממנו י' טפחים ונופל מתוכה לתוכו - כלומר, שהנופל נופל מתוך רה"ר לתוכו, על גגו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:6:1.english: Higher than it [by] ten handbreadths, and [someone] falls from inside it into it - That is to say, that the one who falls falls from inside the public domain into it, onto his roof.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:6:2.english: Exempt - From [the obligation of] the parapet.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:6:3.hebrew: ונפל מתוכו לתוכה - כלומר, שהנופל נופל מגגו לרה"ר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:6:3.english: And fell from inside it into it - That is to say, the one who falls falls from his roof into the public domain.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:7:1.hebrew: למה לי - בית גבוה י', דמשמע הא בציר מהכי פטור ממעקה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:7:1.english: Why do I [need] - a house ten [handbreadths] high, which implies [that] less than this is exempt from a parapet.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:7:2.hebrew: לאו בית הוא - ותורה לא חייבה במעקה אלא בית, ואע"ג דיש חבטה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:7:2.english: It is not a house - And the Torah only obligated a house [to have] a parapet, even though there is impact.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:8:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דטעמא משום דאינו קרוי בית הוא, אמאי קתני "עמוקה ממנו י' טפחים חייב", כי הוי נמי עשרה לצד רה"ר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:8:1.english: If that is so - that the reason is because it is not called a "house," why does [it] teach "[if the public domain is] ten handbreadths deeper than it, he is obligated," even when it is ten [handbreadths] toward the side of the public domain?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:8:2.hebrew: דל תקרה ומעזיבה לא הוי גואי י' - ולא חזי לדירה, ולא הוי בית:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:8:2.english: Remove the ceiling and the plaster, inside it is not ten [handbreadths] - And [therefore] it is not fit for dwelling, and is not [considered] a house.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:9:1.english: You [can] find it - where it is a house.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:9:2.hebrew: דחק ליה מגוואי - עד דהוי מגוואי י' טפחים, והוי בית וחייב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 51a:9:2.english: He hollowed it out from the inside - Until it is ten handbreadths [high] from the inside, and [thus] it is [considered] a house and he is liable.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:14:1.hebrew: בור של שני שותפין היכי משכחת לה - ולא בעי למימר שהפקירו רשותן ובורן, דפטור לכולי עלמא כדפרישית בהמניח (לעיל בבא קמא דף כח: ושם). ולא בעי למימר כגון שחפר זה עשרה וזה עשרים, דאמר לקמן דכולם חייבין; דאבור עשרה דמתניתין קאי:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:14:1.english: "A pit belonging to two partners, how can you find [such a case]?" - And [the Gemara] did not want to say that they renounced ownership of [both] their property and their pit, for [in that case] one is exempt according to everyone, as I explained in [the chapter] HaMeniach (above, Bava Kamma 28b, and there). And it also did not want to say [a case] such as where this one dug ten [handbreadths] and this one [dug to] twenty, where [the Gemara] says below that all of them are liable; because [the Gemara here] is referring to the pit of ten [handbreadths] [mentioned] in the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:19:1.hebrew: בור י' ובא אחר והשלימו לעשרים - והוא הדין לי"א, למאי דפריך עלה מסייד וכייד ומשני: "הא רבי והא רבנן":
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:19:1.english: A pit of ten [handbreadths], and another came and completed it to twenty - And the same law applies to eleven [handbreadths], according to that which [the Gemara] raises an objection against it from [the baraita of] "he plastered and cemented" and answers: "This [baraita] is Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] and that [baraita] is the Rabbis."

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:19:2.hebrew: האחרון חייב - דוקא הוא, בשביל שחידש מיתה שלא היה מתחילה; אבל ראשון ח' וזה ט' — כולם חייבין בנזקין, כמו זה י' וזה עשרים:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:19:2.english: The latter is liable - Specifically he [alone is liable], because he introduced [liability for] death, which was not [present] from the beginning; however, [if] the first [dug] eight [handbreadths] and this [second one dug to] nine — they are all liable for damages, just like [the case of] this one [digging] ten and this one twenty.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:1:1.hebrew: אמרי אין הבל למיתה כו' - והמקשה היה סובר דלענין חבט שייך שפיר "אין חבט למיתה אבל יש חבט לנזקין", אבל לענין הבל היה סובר דאי יש הבל למיתה — יש הבל לנזקין, ואי אין הבל למיתה — לנזקין נמי אין הבל:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:1:1.english: They say: "There are not [sufficient] fumes to [cause] death," etc. - And the questioner had thought that with respect to impact, it is quite applicable [to say] "there is not [sufficient] impact to [cause] death, but there is [sufficient] impact to [cause] injury"; however, with respect to fumes, he had thought that if there are [sufficient] fumes to [cause] death, there are [sufficient] fumes to [cause] injury, and if there are not [sufficient] fumes to [cause] death, for injury as well there are not [sufficient] fumes.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:3:1.hebrew: נעביד פחותה מעשרה - והשתא מדמה טריפות דאדם לטריפות דבהמה, וכן באלו טריפות (חולין דף מג. ושם), ומייתי ראיה מאיוב; וקשה לר"ת דמחלק ביניהם:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 51a:3:1.english: Let us make [it] less than ten [handbreadths] - And now [the Gemara] compares the fatal defects [tereifot] of a human to the tereifot of an animal, and similarly in [the chapter] Eilu Tereifot (Chullin 43a and there), where it brings a proof from Job; and this is difficult for Rabbeinu Tam, who distinguishes between them.
